'''Skeletal Grasp''' is a spell within the [[Arceuus spellbook]] that requires level 56 [[Magic]] and the completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]] to be cast. This spell has a base max hit of 17, and has a 25% chance to stop the target from moving for three [[ticks]] (1.8 seconds); streak marks mid-animation indicate a successful bind on the target.

Skeletal Grasp has a 50% chance to bind a target if the [[Mark of Darkness]] spell is active, though the bind duration remains the same. However, if the target is under the effects of the [[Ward of Arceuus]] spell, they will only be bound in place for one [[tick]] (0.6 seconds) if successfully bound by the caster. In addition, the chance to bind an opponent is only rolled upon a [[successful hit]], which means that a bind will not be rolled for if the spell fails the accuracy roll.
